name: io.github.AKzar1el/mcp-web-validator
title: Web Validator by DigestSEO
description: Audit public webpages and supplied markup for HTML, CSS, SEO, JSON-LD, and link issues.

tools.name: validate_html
tools.description: Validate supplied HTML markup or a single authorized public webpage URL with the Nu HTML Checker. Provide html for markup, or url for a live page. A standalone HTTP(S) URL in html is also fetched rather than treated as HTML. For combined SEO and JSON-LD checks on a live page, use audit_public_webpage.

html.description: Raw HTML markup or one standalone HTTP(S) webpage URL; omit when providing url.

url.description: Public webpage to fetch and validate as HTML; omit when providing html.

tools.name: validate_css
tools.description: Use this when raw CSS source is supplied. Parses it inside the Worker and returns syntax messages without contacting an external service.

css.description: Raw CSS source supplied by the user.

tools.name: audit_seo_metadata
tools.description: Use this for a focused SEO/accessibility-signal check of supplied HTML. It does not fetch a live webpage; use audit_public_webpage for a URL.

html.description: Raw HTML markup supplied by the user; this is not a webpage URL.

tools.name: validate_schema_markup
tools.description: Use this for a focused JSON-LD syntax check of supplied HTML. It parses JSON only and does not validate Schema.org vocabulary semantics.

html.description: Raw HTML markup supplied by the user; this is not a webpage URL.

tools.name: check_broken_links
tools.description: Use this for a focused check of up to 20 public HTTP(S) links found in supplied HTML. It does not fetch base_url, follow redirects, or retain response bodies.

html.description: Raw HTML markup supplied by the user; this is not a webpage URL.

base_url.description: Only resolves relative links; it does not fetch this webpage.

max_links.description: Maximum links to check, from 1 to 20.

tools.name: generate_validation_report
tools.description: Use this when HTML markup is already supplied. Combines Nu HTML validation with local CSS, SEO, accessibility-signal, and JSON-LD syntax checks. It does not fetch a webpage from base_url; use audit_public_webpage for a live URL.

html.description: Raw HTML markup supplied by the user; this is not a webpage URL.

css.description: Optional raw CSS source. Linked stylesheets are not fetched.

check_links.description: Whether to contact eligible public links found in the supplied HTML.

base_url.description: Only resolves relative links when check_links is true; it does not fetch this webpage.

max_links.description: Maximum links to check, from 1 to 20.

tools.name: audit_public_webpage
tools.description: Use this when the user provides one live public webpage URL. Fetches one bounded static HTML response, then runs HTML validation, SEO/accessibility-signal, and JSON-LD syntax checks. It checks links only when requested and does not crawl, execute JavaScript, authenticate, or fetch linked stylesheets. Use only URLs the user owns or is authorized to inspect.

url.description: One authorized public HTTP(S) webpage URL; private pages, credentials, and custom ports are rejected.

check_links.description: Whether to contact eligible public links found on the fetched page.

max_links.description: Maximum links to check, from 1 to 20.

tools.name: audit_public_site
tools.description: Use this for a bounded, sitemap-first audit of a public website the user owns or is authorized to inspect. It fetches at most 8 same-origin HTML pages per call, respects robots.txt, and returns compact page summaries plus deduplicated findings, a sampled canonical/noindex graph, same-language duplicate main-content pairs, evidence-limited empty/short/repeated-boilerplate main-text review, and 16-locale hreflang/canonical clusters. Content quality results are static-text review signals, not usefulness or Google ranking verdicts. Unvisited alternate targets remain unverified; use the local site.hreflang tool with supplied HTML for up to 16 pages. It does not recursively follow HTML links, authenticate, execute JavaScript, fetch assets, or run site-wide link checks. To continue a batch, pass both the returned page offset and discovery fingerprint; changed sitemaps require restarting at offset 0.

site_url.description: Authorized public website URL. The final public origin becomes the crawl boundary.

max_pages.description: Maximum same-origin pages to audit in this call, from 1 to 8.

page_offset.description: Zero-based sitemap-page offset for continuing a capped audit batch.

expected_discovery_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint from the first batch. Required when page_offset > 0 to reject sitemap drift.

tools.name: preview_regression_alerts
tools.description: Fully offline P2-02 MANUAL alert preview for two to ten caller-supplied historical audit snapshots. Configurable sampled-page regression, net error/warning thresholds and up to four consecutive comparable regression steps. Incomplete coverage and changed sitemap are review-only; incomplete or ambiguous defect evidence is suppressed. Output is a preview, NOT a sent notification. No scheduler, network fetch, stored state, webhook, email, Google Search Console or Analytics integration.

saved_at.description: Actual snapshot timestamp with explicit UTC offset; versions must be ordered oldest first.

code.description: Stable machine-readable audit rule identifier when available.
Stable machine-readable audit rule identifier when available.

snapshot.description: Complete previously observed audit_public_site snapshot (compact site-audit fields), not a URL to fetch.

versions.description: Two to ten already-observed timestamped compact site-audit snapshots, oldest first; no URLs are fetched and no history is stored.

dry_run.description: Must remain true; no delivery, automatic polling or schedules exist.

policy.description: Bounded manual-only rule thresholds; no destination addresses or automation settings are accepted.

min_regressed_pages.description: Minimum regressed pages for an unsent preview in the latest fully comparable sampled pair (default 1).

min_net_error_increase.description: Minimum positive net error-count increase across matched completed pages (default 1).

min_net_warning_increase.description: Minimum positive net warning-count increase across matched completed pages (default 1).

min_coverage_lost_pages.description: Minimum completed pages losing coverage to trigger a review-only observation (default 1).

consecutive_regressing_steps.description: How many fully comparable consecutive regressing samples are required for the page-regression rule (default 1).

review_coverage_loss.description: Whether to preview validator coverage loss as a review-only observation (default true).

review_sitemap_drift.description: Whether to preview sitemap fingerprint drift as a review-only observation (default true).

tools.name: compare_production_snapshots
tools.description: V10 offline comparison of two caller-supplied HTML versions of one safe page, oldest first. SHA-256 page/content fingerprints, static metadata/robots/canonicals, links and bounded main text differences. Failed HTTP delivery suppresses HTML repair claims. No fetch, browser, storage, deployment, Google indexing, traffic or ranking inference.

page_url.description: Exact same safe URL of both observations, not fetched.

observed_at.description: Offset-aware ISO capture timestamp claimed by caller; not independently observed.

http_status.description: Observed HTTP status code, optional when the delivery status was not captured.

html.description: Caller-supplied static HTML body, at most 180,000 UTF-8 bytes.

baseline.description: Earlier captured HTML and claimed response time/status.

observed_at.description: Offset-aware ISO capture timestamp claimed by caller; not independently observed.

http_status.description: Observed HTTP status code, optional when the delivery status was not captured.

html.description: Caller-supplied static HTML body, at most 180,000 UTF-8 bytes.

current.description: Later captured HTML and claimed response time/status.

tools.name: compare_historical_audits
tools.description: Pure, offline historical trends for 2–10 supplied timestamped compact audit_public_site results in oldest-first order. Compares adjacent and first/last observations and error/warning trends for the exact page cohort fully checked in every version. Distinguishes coverage loss from improvements and gates disappearing issue groups on fully checked identical sitemap samples. No hosted storage, saved IDs, scheduled monitoring, network requests, raw site URLs/messages, or ranking/indexing assertions.

saved_at.description: Actual snapshot timestamp with explicit UTC offset; versions must be ordered oldest first.

code.description: Stable machine-readable audit rule identifier when available.
Stable machine-readable audit rule identifier when available.

snapshot.description: Complete previously observed audit_public_site snapshot (compact site-audit fields), not a URL to fetch.

versions.description: Two to ten caller-supplied timestamped compact site-audit results, oldest first; <=60 KB each and 610 KB combined. Hosted service never reads a local archive or stores versions.

tools.name: compare_site_audits
tools.description: Compare the structured results of two earlier audit_public_site runs entirely offline. Identify changed page issue counts, unavailable checks, sitemap drift, and newly/no-longer observed grouped findings only within the same fully checked selected-page sample (not site-wide). This is not a Google indexing, ranking, or traffic-causality test. No webpages are fetched and results are not stored.

code.description: Stable machine-readable audit rule identifier when available.
Stable machine-readable audit rule identifier when available.

baseline.description: Earlier structuredContent from audit_public_site, without editing its page list.

code.description: Stable machine-readable audit rule identifier when available.
Stable machine-readable audit rule identifier when available.

current.description: Later structuredContent from audit_public_site, ideally the same sitemap batch.

tools.name: verify_product_claims
tools.description: Compare visible explicit ChatGPT-tool promises and bounded site-batch claims from authorized landing-page HTML or a single public URL against this Worker runtime's actually registered MCP tool names, input bounds, and read-only annotations. This is registry consistency, not proof that every tool call succeeds or that arbitrary marketing copy is true. No login, browser rendering or site-wide crawl.

html.description: Static landing-page HTML, at most 250,000 UTF-8 bytes. Supply this or public_url, not both.

public_url.description: Alternative to HTML: one authorized public landing page, using the existing safe single-page fetch.

tools.name: verify_content_provenance
tools.description: Compare up to eight already-supplied static HTML pages with optional caller-supplied citation, dataset and methodology metadata. Verify explicit URL/ID agreement, dataset versions and as-of dates, publication chronology, and only caller-defined freshness windows. The Worker does not fetch sources, datasets or pages, and missing evidence is unverified rather than a fabricated factual verdict.

url.description: Safe public-style URL label only; never fetched.

pages.description: One to eight authorized static HTML page observations, combined cap 1 MB.

evidence.description: Optional caller-provided source URLs and dataset/method metadata; not independently fact-checked.

tools.name: compare_competitor_intent
tools.description: Bounded offline analysis of one primary and up to six caller-supplied competitor HTML pages. Compares explicit static informational/commercial/transactional/navigational signals and optional caller-selected intent or lexical query-heading overlap. No page, competitor, SERP, GSC or ranking requests; not a semantic SEO verdict.

primary.description: Primary static HTML observation; the URL is a label, never fetched.

competitors.description: One to six caller-authorized competitor observations with distinct origins; none are fetched.

expected_intent.description: Optional target intent selected by the caller, not inferred by the model or the query.

query.description: Optional caller-supplied query for exact normalized heading-token overlap; not echoed.

tools.name: validate_supported_schema
tools.description: Bounded offline JSON-LD structure review for Article, NewsArticle, BlogPosting, Product, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Organization and WebSite. Reports limited property/profile findings without fetching remote contexts or validating rich-result eligibility. Existing validate_schema_markup remains the independent syntax-only check. Unknown types and contexts remain unverified.

html.description: Caller-supplied HTML containing explicit JSON-LD scripts, 250 KB UTF-8 maximum; never fetched.

tools.name: review_internal_link_graph
tools.description: V06: compare up to eight caller-supplied same-origin static page observations (including navigation anchors), optional entry roots and up to 256 previously observed sitemap labels; or sample robots.txt and up to three guarded same-origin HTML pages. Reports sample-only shortest depths, missing inbound links, potential orphan leads, nofollow-only paths, and independently observed blocked/HTTP-error/noindex/noncanonical targets. Never assumes unsampled pages are orphans or verifies Google indexing. No raw URLs/HTML, JavaScript, GSC, storage, crawler impersonation or full-site crawl.

url.description: Live: one authorized public query-free entry URL; bounded robots.txt and up to three HTML page fetches.

site_url.description: Offline: exact-origin site URL; no network requests.

pages.description: Offline: one to eight previously observed HTML/status/robots/canonical page records.

entry_urls.description: Optional entry roots; by default only an included site homepage is used.

sitemap_urls.description: Optional independent sitemap URL observations, never fetched or called confirmed orphans.

tools.name: review_internal_links
tools.description: Offline, bounded analysis of 1-8 caller-supplied same-origin HTML pages. Looks at contextual same-origin links, missing accessible names, generic anchors, repeated target labels, internal nofollow, and lexical overlap with supplied target titles/H1. Unknown URLs remain unverified, not broken. No requests, crawls, search analytics, JavaScript or ranking inference.

pages.description: One to eight authorized same-origin static HTML page samples, distinct URL labels and combined limit 900,000 UTF-8 bytes; none are fetched.

tools.name: review_metadata_consistency
tools.description: Offline, bounded comparison of 1-8 caller-supplied same-origin static HTML pages. Reviews repeated/conflicting titles, descriptions and canonical preferences; Open Graph/Twitter text differences; explicit robots directives; and duplicate titles/descriptions across distinct sampled canonical preferences. No network requests, Google-selected canonical verification, rendering, ranking inference, or storage.

pages.description: One to eight authorized same-origin static HTML pages with distinct safe URL labels; 900,000 UTF-8 bytes combined, none fetched.

tools.name: review_sitemap_inventory
tools.description: V05: compare up to eight caller-supplied XML/text sitemap documents, independently discovered URLs and page status/robots/noindex/canonical evidence; or fetch one safe public sitemap and up to two same-origin child sitemaps. Reports malformed, duplicated, missing or external entries, lastmod anomalies and observed indexability conflicts without pretending sampled URLs prove full coverage or Google indexing. No raw URLs, XML source, external storage, crawler impersonation, page crawling or production writes.

url.description: Live: one authorized query-free public site URL; sitemap defaults to /sitemap.xml.

sitemap_url.description: Live: optional same-origin query-free sitemap URL.

site_url.description: Offline: public site whose sitemaps are provided.

documents.description: Offline: 1–8 previously acquired XML or plain-text sitemap contents.

discovered_urls.description: Optional independent discovered URLs, not fetched in this call.

page_observations.description: Optional HTTP/indexing evidence for up to 250 known pages.

tools.name: review_redirect_canonical_chains
tools.description: V04: review up to eight supplied ordered HTTP response hops with redirects and static HTML/HTTP canonical plus X-Robots-Tag evidence; or probe a bounded same-origin public GET chain and static HTML destination. Detects loops, chain mismatches, missing or unsafe Location, 4xx/5xx/noindex destinations, conflicting/cyclic canonical declarations and non-matching explicit expected targets. Does not impersonate Googlebot, retrieve Google indexing decisions, store response bodies or echo raw URLs/tokens. Hosted live mode charges rate limit per outgoing request.

url.description: One authorized query-free public URL for a bounded live GET chain.

source_url.description: Offline mode: source URL label; first supplied observation must match.

observations.description: Offline: one to eight ordered observed redirect/status/canonical records.

expected_destination.description: Optional expected final URL to identify an observed destination mismatch.

tools.name: review_crawler_access
tools.description: V03: compare up to eight user-provided same-origin page observations, static HTML meta robots and X-Robots-Tag against crawler-specific robots.txt rules for Googlebot desktop/smartphone/news/image, Bingbot and GPTBot. Alternatively fetch a single public page and robots.txt with the service's own User-Agent, applying public URL and robots guards and charging per outgoing GET. Crawl permission is NOT an indexing verdict; this does not impersonate or authenticate search crawlers, execute JS, store HTML or inspect crawler logs.

url.description: Live: one authorized public query-free page URL; omit offline fields.

site_url.description: Offline: origin URL to compare with the supplied pages.

robots_txt.description: Offline: previously acquired robots.txt text, maximum 64 KB.

robots_status_code.description: Offline: actual observed robots.txt status; 429 and 5xx remain unknown.

pages.description: Offline: one to eight page URL, HTTP, static HTML and header samples.

profiles.description: Optional distinct profiles, six available and all checked by default.

tools.name: review_availability_history
tools.description: V02: compare two to 48 caller-supplied chronological HTTP/transport outcomes, or take two to three bounded live public GET observations. Counts intermittent success/non-success, HTTP 429/5xx, explicit challenges, timeouts and status transitions. Sample rate is not continuous uptime. No cloud persistence, scheduler, Googlebot verification, JavaScript, response bodies or raw URL/header output.

url.description: One authorized public, query-free URL for a short live 2–3 GET burst.

checks.description: Two or three live GET observations, default three; omit for offline input.

observations.description: Previously collected chronological HTTP or transport outcomes; no network requests.

tools.name: diagnose_http_delivery
tools.description: V01: bounded single public HTTP GET (up to three same-origin redirects) or up to four already-supplied HTTP response hops. Identifies 403, 429, 5xx, incomplete redirects, cache-state flags, Retry-After, and cf-mitigated challenge evidence. No response body, scripts, cookies, authenticated browser, Googlebot identity verification, historical monitoring or raw header/URL-token output.

url.description: One authorized public query-free HTTP(S) URL to probe once (GET).

observations.description: One to four already-observed ordered response hops instead of making an HTTP request.

tools.name: review_url_variants
tools.description: Fully offline comparison of one explicit query-free reference and 1–12 caller-observed same-path HTTP(S), apex/www, slash, ASCII case and query URL variants. Uses supplied response status, one-step Location, up to three canonical declarations and optional caller-computed 200-body SHA-256 fingerprints. No website fetch, redirect following, content/Google canonical equivalence assumptions, stored history or URL/query/secret leakage.

reference_url.description: Explicit query-free HTTP(S) preferred reference URL, also required among supplied observations.

url.description: Exact caller-observed URL including optional query values, which are never fetched or returned.

status_code.description: Actual caller-observed HTTP response code; tool makes no HTTP requests.

method.description: Actual observed request method; HEAD cannot provide a body fingerprint.

location.description: Optional raw one-step HTTP Location redirect target; relative references allowed; no redirects followed.

canonicals.description: Zero to three caller-observed canonical declarations, absolute or relative; not Google's chosen canonical.

content_sha256.description: Optional caller-computed exact HTTP 200 response-body SHA-256 hex; never returned or verified here.

observations.description: One to twelve actual same-family response observations; no network or browser requests are made.

tools.name: review_https_security
tools.description: Offline bounded security-header and static HTML review across 1–8 same-host HTTP/HTTPS caller observations. HTTP→HTTPS Location declarations, HSTS status, enforcing versus report-only CSP, referrer/nosniff/frame protections and potential mixed-content/script/style/media/form declarations. No site fetch, TLS/certificate verification, browser execution, resource requests or leakage of raw URLs/headers/HTML. Not a production security verdict.

url.description: Safe caller-observed HTTP or HTTPS page label, not fetched or returned.

status_code.description: Observed HTTP response code; no live fetch or redirect following.

location.description: Optional actual Location header from HTTP response, not returned.

strict_transport_security.description: Up to four observed Strict-Transport-Security response header values.

content_security_policy.description: Up to four enforcing Content-Security-Policy response header values.

content_security_policy_report_only.description: Up to four Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only headers, not enforced by the browser.

htmlContent.description: Optional supplied static HTML, max 120 KB/page and 300 KB combined; no resources fetched or executed.

pages.description: One to eight same-host HTTP/HTTPS supplied observations with response codes, optional headers and HTML; max 24 KB header and 300 KB HTML budgets.

tools.name: review_http_directives
tools.description: Offline, bounded analysis of one to eight caller-supplied same-origin HTTP response header observations for PDFs and media: MIME, X-Robots-Tag scopes and conflicts, HTTP Link rel=canonical, attachment disposition and response status. No binary fetch, robots.txt request, storage, Google indexing assertion or raw URL/header leakage.

url.description: Safe HTTP(S) URL label for this response, not fetched or echoed.

status_code.description: HTTP status observed by the caller, not a crawler/indexing verdict.

method.description: Actual method used for the supplied header observation when known.

content_type.description: Optional raw Content-Type response header value.

content_disposition.description: Optional raw Content-Disposition header; filenames will not be returned.

x_robots_tag.description: Up to eight X-Robots-Tag HTTP header values, supplied in order.

link.description: Up to eight Link HTTP header values, including rel=canonical declarations.

resources.description: One to eight authorized same-origin supplied HTTP response observations, up to 30 KB combined header values; no network requests are made.
